description.value: The Boxcar is a cozy cocktail bar and beer parlour on Vancouver's Main Street corridor, pouring craft cocktails and local beers alongside Roma-style pizza from award-winning Mortadella Pizzeria located next door. Named among Canada's Top 50 bars in 2020, it has a neighbourhood feel with indoor seating and a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere. A solid after-ride destination in the Mount Pleasant area for cyclists looking to unwind.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 37m; stands (2 spaces) at 42m; stands (2 spaces) at 58m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Boxcar is an active cocktail bar and beer parlour at 917 Main Street, Vancouver, with phone 604-239-7109 consistent with the OSM-listed address; the OSM record itself carried no phone. The site shows a clearly operational business with NYE 2026 event tickets on sale and an active pizza partnership with Mortadella Pizzeria next door. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenity appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags; the pizza menu ingredient listings confirm vegetarian options (Margherita, Caprese) are available.
concerns: OSM record carries no phone number; phone 604-239-7109 sourced from website only and could not be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating cocktail bar with confirmed address, current events on sale, and a live website. Publicly accessible and useful to touring cyclists seeking food and drink on the Main Street corridor.
